seemp.title: SEEMP
seemp.description: Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan: energy-efficiency measures recommended per vessel, a simulation of their CII impact and their costs and benefits.

air_lubrication.name: Hull air cavity lubrication
air_lubrication.description: A layer of air under the hull lowers the frictional resistance.

resistance_reduction_devices.name: Resistance reduction devices
resistance_reduction_devices.description: Modified and installed resistance reduction devices on the hull.

hull_coating.name: Hull coating maintenance
hull_coating.description: Recoating and cleaning keep the hull surface smooth.

power_system_machinery.name: Variable speed power generation
power_system_machinery.description: Generator speed follows the ship's electrical load.

propulsion_efficiency_devices.name: Propulsion efficiency devices
propulsion_efficiency_devices.description: Devices around the propeller (e.g. pre-swirl stators) raise the propulsive efficiency.

waste_heat_recovery.name: Waste heat recovery
waste_heat_recovery.description: Engine waste heat is turned into useful energy on board.

lng.name: LNG for main and auxiliary engines
lng.description: A switch to LNG with a lower CO₂ conversion factor.

biofuel.name: Biofuels for main and auxiliary engines

solar.name: Solar panels
solar.description: Solar energy supplies part of the ship's electricity.

wind.name: Wind power
wind.description: Wind energy supplies part of the ship's electricity.

cold_ironing.name: Cold ironing (shore power)
cold_ironing.description: Shore electricity at berth replaces the auxiliary engines in port.

fuel_cells.name: Fuel cells
fuel_cells.description: Fuel cells supply the ship's electricity.

notAvailable.title: No baseline CII for this vessel yet
notAvailable.description: SEEMP recommendations need the CII of a baseline year (from voyage segments or a manual record). Check the vessel's CII history or enter a manual record for the previous year.

vesselNotFound.title: Vessel not found
vesselNotFound.description: The emission service knows no vessel with this MMSI. Check the vessel's MMSI.

forbidden.title: This vessel belongs to another organization
forbidden.description: SEEMP data is private to each organization. Switch to the vessel's organization to see it.

reductionFactorMissing.title: Reduction factor Z not available
reductionFactorMissing.description: The required CII of the target year cannot be computed. Pick another target year or ask a platform administrator to add the factor Z.

measureUnknown.title: Unknown measure
measureUnknown.description: One of the selected measures is not in the service's catalog. Reload the page and select again.

incompatible.title: Invalid combination of measures
incompatible.description: Only one fuel switch (LNG or biofuel) can be simulated at a time.

scenarioNotFound.title: Scenario not found
scenarioNotFound.description: This scenario was deleted or belongs to another organization.

validation.title: Invalid data
validation.description: Check the input and try again.

reduction.operational: Up to {{p}}% less CII, in proportion to the share of the year at sea
reduction.fuelSwitch: Fuel switch: C_F {{cf}} t CO₂/t fuel
reduction.coldIroning: Shore power at berth: less auxiliary fuel in port ({{share}}% potential)
reduction.auxiliary: Replaces {{share}}% of the auxiliary engine fuel

cost.powerBoth: {{usd}} per kW of main + auxiliary power
cost.powerMain: {{usd}} per kW of main engine power

catalog.title: Catalog of the 12 SEEMP measures
catalog.description: Energy-efficiency measures with their reduction model, investment cost and source. Cost per year of a vessel = investment divided by the years until the grade falls to D/E.
catalog.note: Potentials and costs come from the MVP model (thesis) and are flagged as needing a citation in the methodology catalog.
catalog.emptyDescription: The emission service has no SEEMP measures yet. Contact a platform administrator.

recommendations.title: Recommended measures
recommendations.description: Measures that keep the vessel at grades A–C in {{year}}, cheapest per year first.
recommendations.emptyDescription: No single measure brings the vessel to grades A–C. Try a combination of measures in the simulation panel.

simulation.title: Measure simulation
simulation.description: Pick measures and run the simulation to see their combined CII, grade, cost and benefit.
simulation.incompatible: LNG and biofuels both switch the fuel: pick only one of them.
simulation.stale: The selection changed; run the simulation again
simulation.readOnlyTitle: Simulation is not available for your role
simulation.readOnlyDescription: Running and saving simulations needs the seemp:simulate permission (fleet managers or organization admins).

scenarios.title: Saved scenarios
scenarios.description: Every simulation scenario of the organization, newest first. Pick up to three scenarios to compare.
scenarios.vesselDescription: Simulations saved for this vessel. Pick up to three scenarios to compare.
scenarios.name: Scenario name
scenarios.saveFailed: The scenario could not be saved
scenarios.viewDescription: Baseline year {{baseline}} → target year {{target}} · saved {{time}}. The result is the simulation at saving time.
scenarios.deleteDescription: Scenario "{{name}}" is deleted permanently. The action is recorded in the audit log.
scenarios.deleteFailed: The scenario could not be deleted
scenarios.emptyDescription: Run a simulation on a vessel's page and save the result as a scenario.
scenarios.emptyReadOnly: Fleet managers create scenarios from a vessel's simulation.

compare.title: Scenario comparison
compare.description: Scenarios side by side; every result is the simulation at its saving time.

vessels.title: Fleet vessels ({{year}})
vessels.description: Pick a vessel to see the recommended measures and run simulations. The grade is the current year's CII.
vessels.emptyTitle: No vessels in this fleet yet
vessels.emptyDescription: Add vessels in the Vessels module; recommendations become available once their CII is computed.
vessels.noFleetTitle: The fleet list is not available
vessels.noFleetDescription: The list needs the cii:read permission. Open a vessel directly with its MMSI.

baseline.gradeDescription: Grade of {{year}}, the starting point of the recommendations

kpi.needActionDescription: Vessels rated D or E in {{year}}
kpi.measuresDescription: Technical, operational, fuel and auxiliary-energy measures

priority.correctiveHint: Grade D or E: a corrective action plan is required in SEEMP Part III.
priority.monitorHint: Grade C: meets the required CII without margin; the required CII tightens every year.
priority.compliantHint: Grade A or B: better than required.
priority.noDataHint: No counted segments and no manual record for this year yet.
